newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower, wait for direction.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower, wait for direction.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed down as investors took profit and waited for corporate results for the quarter to September 30, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.58 points down at 597.47. Price declines led gains by 25 to 14. Development Finance Corporation fell two rupees to 272, Hayleys 3.50 to 191.50.
"Investors who bought the market as it gained from around 550 points are continuing to take profit," said Dimuthu Abeysekera of Allied Phillips Securities.
The all share index rose to about 608 points before profit-taking set in, and brokers said investors pause to book gains every time the index rose by about 10 percent.

"The profit-taking should bring the all share to about 580 points, where support should return due to healthy corporate results for the quarter to September 30," said Sriyan Gurusinghe of Bartleet Mallory Stock Brokers.
Turnover was 15 million rupees boosted by local buying of 1.3 million Distillery shares at 6.50 rupees.
Foreign buying would return once the index had settled, brokers said. -- Prithi Kodagoda (941) 434319
